start: Next UTC midnight strictly after registration plus five minutes
primaryMeasure: Fraction of provider-reported 30s quote failures excluded at the unchanged 0.5 threshold
pairedSafetyMeasure: Fraction of successful on-time 30s quotes retained; report unknowns separately in both partitions
secondaryMeasures: Frozen legacy Brier/log loss/AUC versus the original training-rate constant
30s and 120s returned-quote outcomes for all, selected and excluded watches
Day counts, missing outcomes, illustrative cost stress and best-token/day removal
tokens: Exclude original training tokens and all admitted tokens in the completed development captures; first compatible admitted signal per new token only
review: No predictions or outcome summaries before the fixed end plus maturity. Counts are guards, not statistical power or automatic approval. No extension or early stopping to force a result.
